articles.title: Scientists Build a Clock That Keeps Itself on Time Using Atomic Nuclei
articles.summary: A team in Vienna made the first self-stabilizing nuclear clock, which uses thorium nuclei to keep a laser ticking steadily.

articles.title: Why a 100-Year-Old Mushroom Disease Is So Hard to Stop
articles.summary: Scientists found that a mushroom disease called bacterial blotch involves more than 17 kinds of harmful bacteria, not just one.

articles.title: Why Some People Hear Music That Isn't Really Playing
articles.summary: A new study looked at 80 people who hear songs that are not there, and found the tunes often come from long-ago memories.
